row: We are Therapeutic Associates Inc. (TAI), a physical therapist-owned and operated partnership of clinics. Our structure is unique and has contributed to our significant history and success. Each clinic director is a practicing PT and owner in their facility and is committed to providing you with the highest quality care and customer service available. All clinics share administrative services and many other resources that allow us to learn from each other and grow together. But, each clinic operates autonomously to best serve its staff, its neighborhood, and you.
